# Which table each display item is computed from

This file is generated from the code that makes each display item, not transcribed from captions:
the table typesetter (`06_manuscript/CTR/2026-09-06-typeset-tables.py`, shipped in this package) and the
figure scripts (`03_code/src/viz/`) are read for the files each item is built from. Paths are relative to
`05_results/tables/` in a run of this package, and to `05_results/reference/` for the copies we obtained.

**This mapping is not the guarantee.** The guarantee is reproduction: `bash run_all.sh` regenerates, from both cities' data, every
table below and `python 03_code/verify.py` checks each one against the shipped reference copy (coverage
exact, widths to 1e-12 relative). `python 06_manuscript/CTR/2026-09-06-typeset-tables.py` then reads
those tables and writes every number of every table body to `06_manuscript/CTR/_build/typeset.json`.

## How this file was made

`06_manuscript/CTR/2026-11-24-display-item-sources.py` (in the source repository): a def-use pass over the typesetter gives the
files behind each typeset value, and the same pass over the two manuscript generators places each value
in the display item or section it is printed in. Every file the typesetter reads, every value the
generators print and every float of the built documents is accounted for, or the script stops, and a
planted read into the Table 2 body is attributed to Table 2 (positive control: PASS).
